summary: The MCP context tool must list the novel batch commands under command_mirror_capabilities, but only those the runtime Cobra-tree mirror actually registered with the child-cli tenant gate.
reason: The generated tools.go has no capability listing for hand-written commands, so agents would not discover that address clean, trip quote, coverage check and fleet plan are available through the MCP shell-out mirror. registeredCommandMirrorCapabilities drops any entry the mirror did not register, so the list cannot advertise a tool that is missing.
